# jamfplatform_pro_ebook (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro ebook by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. Surfaces a flat read-only projection; manage the ebook as a resource for full detail.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `read:pro:ebooks` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an ebook by exact name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_ebook" "by_name" {
  name = "Field Operations Guide"
}

# Or look up by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_ebook" "by_id" {
  id = "79"
}

output "ebook_url" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_ebook.by_name.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Ebook ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Ebook display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) Ebook author.
- `category_id` (String) Category ID.
- `category_name` (String) Category display name.
- `deploy_as_managed` (Boolean) Whether the ebook is managed when possible.
- `deployment_type` (String) Distribution Method.
- `file_type` (String) File Type.
- `free` (Boolean) Whether the ebook is free.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. `-1` means no site.
- `site_name` (String) Site display name.
- `url` (String) Ebook URL.
- `version` (String) Ebook version.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
